title: Watch Where You Linearize: Predicting and Correcting Model-Merging Interference
abstract: arXiv:2611.25000v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Model merging combines separately fine-tuned models by adding their task vectors to a shared backbone. Interference is typically assessed only after constructing and evaluating a candidate merge, making coefficient search expensive. We show that a first-order directional derivative of task A's outputs along task B's vector can predict interference, but only when evaluated at the appropriate model.   At the receiver model, this derivative forecasts nearby merges per task and per example, halves the accuracy error of a no-change baseline, and identifies most examples whose predictions flip. For full multi-task merges, a single evaluation is insufficient; two evaluations along the merge path are needed. At the shared pretrained backbone, however, the derivative is nearly orthogonal to realized changes in our vision experiments and only partly predictive in LoRA language-model pilots. translated_title: 注意你在哪里线性化：预测与校正模型合并中的干扰
translated_abstract: 模型合并通过将各自微调得到的任务向量加到共享主干网络上，从而组合多个分别微调的模型。目前对干扰的评估通常只能在构建并测试候选合并之后进行，这使得系数搜索的成本很高。我们证明，任务A的输出沿任务B向量方向的一阶方向导数可以预测干扰，但前提是必须在合适的模型处进行评估。在接收模型处，该导数能够逐任务、逐样本地预测邻近的合并结果，将无变化基线的准确率误差减半，并识别出大多数预测发生翻转的样本。对于完整的多任务合并，单次评估是不够的，需要沿合并路径进行两次评估。然而，在共享的预训练主干处，该导数在我们的视觉实验中与实际发生的变化几乎正交，在LoRA语言模型的初步实验中也仅具有部分预测能力。控制实验将这种失败与沿接收模型的位移联系起来。
tldr: 该论文发现，一阶方向导数只有在接收模型处评估才能有效预测模型合并中的干扰——可将基线准确率误差减半，而在共享预训练主干处评估则几乎无法预测干扰。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that a first-order directional derivative predicts model-merging interference only when evaluated at the receiver model—halving the accuracy error of a no-change baseline—while evaluations at the shared pretrained backbone fail to predict interference.
